responsibility: Provides the AIX 5.1-specific rs6000 subtarget configuration layered over the generic AIX/XCOFF support. It owns the AIX 5.1 option-override rules for maix64 and PowerPC64 consistency, assembler CPU mapping strings, predefined _AIX43/_AIX51 macros, library/link/startfile specs, ABI-relevant type definitions such as ptrdiff_t and wchar_t, and the release marker TARGET_AIX_VERSION, while still disabling Altivec for this OS generation.
